edits.old: For each returned heading, collect every enumerated source subject whose own wording passes the parent check. The heading's own entry represents a source subject with the same meaning; place every more-specific compatible source subject among its descendants. Complete that collection at every numbered occurrence of the heading, even when its surrounding branch differs.
edits.new: For each enumerated complete source subject, use its own wording to find every returned heading whose parent check it passes. An equal-meaning heading's own entry already represents that source subject; place it among the descendants of every more-general compatible heading, independently for every numbered occurrence even when the surrounding branch differs.
